packs.toml:
# codebase-memory-mcp: indexed code graph (symbol search, code search,
# architecture overview). The repository must be indexed in
# codebase-memory; harness refreshes that index after syncs but never
# creates one.
type = "mcp"
command = "codebase-memory-mcp"
freshness = "indexed"
# Text search answered empty in 95% of calls and never surfaced a changed
# file (alpha evaluation 2026-10-10); rg-fd and ripwire serve it. The
# mapping stays below for anyone who routes it back with only = [...].
only = ["code.symbol_search", "project.overview", "arch.duplicates"]

# codebase-memory names projects itself: find this repository's name.
[resolve]
tool = "list_projects"
items = "projects"
match = "root_path"
value = "name"
fix = "index it with codebase-memory's index_repository tool (repo_path={root})"

[refresh]
tool = "index_repository"
args = { repo_path = "{root}" }

[capabilities."code.symbol_search"]
tool = "search_graph"
args = { project = "{project}", query = "{query}", limit = "{limit}" }
items = "results"
fields = { name = "name", qualified_name = "qualified_name", label = "label", path = "file_path", start_line = "start_line", end_line = "end_line", score = "rank" }
truncated = "has_more"

[capabilities."code.text_search"]
tool = "search_code"
args = { project = "{project}", pattern = "{query}", limit = "{limit}" }
items = "results"
# The hit line is the first matching line, not the enclosing node's start.
fields = { name = "node", qualified_name = "qualified_name", label = "label", path = "file", start_line = "match_lines.0", snippet = "match_lines" }

[capabilities."project.overview"]
tool = "get_architecture"
args = { project = "{project}" }

# Duplicates (HAR-0141): the graph's SIMILAR_TO edges (MinHash Jaccard of
# the bodies) between functions, then between methods; its Cypher has no
# label alternation, so one query each, combined. Asking for one row more
# than the limit tells whether more exist. The other copy's line is left
# out: the graph reports the first copy's there.
[capabilities."arch.duplicates"]
tool = "query_graph"
args = { project = "{project}", max_rows = "{limit_more}", query = "MATCH (a:Function)-[r:SIMILAR_TO]->(b:Function) RETURN a.name, a.qualified_name, a.file_path, a.start_line, a.end_line, b.name, b.file_path, r.jaccard ORDER BY a.file_path, a.start_line, b.file_path LIMIT {limit_more}" }
items = "rows"
fields = { name = "0", qualified_name = "1", path = "2", start_line = "3", end_line = "4", related_name = "5", related_path = "6", confidence = "7" }
evidence = "inferred"
combine = "all"

[[capabilities."arch.duplicates".chain]]
tool = "query_graph"
args = { project = "{project}", max_rows = "{limit_more}", query = "MATCH (a:Method)-[r:SIMILAR_TO]->(b:Method) RETURN a.name, a.qualified_name, a.file_path, a.start_line, a.end_line, b.name, b.file_path, r.jaccard ORDER BY a.file_path, a.start_line, b.file_path LIMIT {limit_more}" }
items = "rows"
fields = { name = "0", qualified_name = "1", path = "2", start_line = "3", end_line = "4", related_name = "5", related_path = "6", confidence = "7" }
evidence = "inferred"

# graphify-csharp (Roslyn-based C# facts) through harness-graphify, which
# speaks the harness provider protocol (installed with harness). Compiler-
# resolved callers and references; its symbol search matches names only,
# so it is limited to callers/references in C# projects.
type = "harness"
command = "harness-graphify"
dir = "project"
only = ["code.callers", "code.references", "code.impact"]
# In get_context its callers/impact surfaced 1-2% of the changed files at a
# p95 of 20 s (alpha evaluation 2026-10-10): search_project only.
context = false
languages = ["csharp"]

# NugetMcpServer (https://github.com/DimonSmart/NugetMcpServer), verified
# with 1.1.9: public API of NuGet packages for package_api.
type = "mcp"
command = "NugetMcpServer"
timeout_ms = 60000
languages = ["csharp"]

[capabilities."package.search"]
tool = "search_packages"
args = { query = "{query}", maxResults = "{limit}" }
items = "packages"
fields = { name = "packageId", label = "version", snippet = "description", score = "downloadCount" }

[capabilities."package.info"]
tool = "get_package_info"
args = { packageId = "{package}", version = "{version}" }

[capabilities."package.types"]
tool = "list_classes_records_structs"
args = { packageId = "{package}", version = "{version}", filter = "{query}" }
items = "types"
fields = { name = "name", qualified_name = "fullName", label = "kind" }
combine = "all"
chain = [
  { tool = "list_interfaces", args = { packageId = "{package}", version = "{version}", filter = "{query}" }, items = "interfaces", fields = { name = "name", qualified_name = "fullName" } },
]

[capabilities."package.type_definition"]
tool = "get_class_or_record_or_struct_definition"
args = { packageId = "{package}", typeName = "{type}", version = "{version}" }
miss = "not found in package"
chain = [
  { tool = "get_interface_definition", args = { packageId = "{package}", interfaceName = "{type}", version = "{version}" }, miss = "not found in package" },
  { tool = "get_enum_definition", args = { packageId = "{package}", enumName = "{type}", version = "{version}" }, miss = "not found in package" },
]

# rg-fd MCP (ripgrep + fd): live text and file search in the working tree,
# which becomes its allowed root.
type = "mcp"
command = "rg-fd-mcp"
dir = "project"

# Queries are plain text; rg and fd take regular expressions. Matches come
# per file ({"matches": {"<file>": {"lines": [...]}}}); problems come back
# as a {"code", "message"} body.
[capabilities."code.text_search"]
tool = "rg_search"
args = { pattern = "{query_regex}", context_lines = 0, max_results = "{limit}", path = "{abs_path}" }
items = "matches.*.lines"
where = { is_match = true }
fields = { path = "$key", start_line = "line_num", snippet = "content" }
truncated = "_truncated"
error = "message"

[capabilities."code.file_search"]
tool = "fd_find"
args = { pattern = "{query_regex}", max_results = "{limit}", path = "{abs_path}" }
items = "files"
fields = { path = "file" }
truncated = "_truncated"
error = "message"

# ripwire (https://github.com/redhat-et/ripwire), verified with 0.6.4.
# Task-ranked symbol search, text search, name-based callers/references.
type = "mcp"
command = "ripwire"
args = ["--mcp"]
dir = "project"          # indexes its working directory
freshness = "indexed"

[capabilities."code.symbol_search"]
tool = "for"
args = { task = "{query}", limit = "{limit}" }
truncated = 'capped="1"' 
pattern = '<f p="(?P<path>[^"]+)" score="(?P<score>\d+)"[^>]*sym="(?P<name>[^"]*)"'

[capabilities."code.text_search"]
tool = "grep"
args = { pattern = "{query}", limit = "{limit}" }
items = "hits"
fields = { path = "file", start_line = "line", name = "in" }

[capabilities."code.callers"]
tool = "find_referencing_symbols"
args = { symbol = "{query_name}" }   # ripwire takes plain names, not Type.Member
miss = "symbol not found"            # an unknown name: no callers, not a failure
items = "calledBy"
fields = { name = "name", label = "kind", path = "file", start_line = "line" }

[capabilities."code.references"]
tool = "uses"
args = { symbol = "{query_name}", limit = "{limit}" }
miss = "symbol not found"
truncated = 'has_more="1"'        # ripwire's own "more rows exist" flag
pattern = '<u role="(?P<label>[^"]+)" p="(?P<path>[^":]+):(?P<start_line>\d+)"(?: in_id="(?P<name>[^"]*)")?'

# Transitive blast radius (callers of callers, tests included); no hop
# counts in the response, so depth stays 0.
[capabilities."code.impact"]
tool = "impact"
args = { symbol = "{query_name}", limit = "{limit}" }
miss = "symbol not found"
pattern = '<s t="(?P<label>[^"]+)" n="(?P<name>[^"]+)" p="(?P<path>[^":]+):(?P<start_line>\d+)"'
truncated = 'capped="1"'

# Change coupling from the Git history (HAR-0141): the files that changed
# in the same commits as the queried file; deg is the share of its commits
# (ripwire mines an 18-month window). No hotspot list over MCP (its churn
# ranking is CLI-only), so a query naming the file is needed.
[capabilities."arch.change_coupling"]
tool = "cochange"
args = { file = "{query}", limit = "{limit}" }
items = "rows"
fields = { path = "file", count = "together", confidence = "deg" }
truncated = "has_more"
evidence = "exact"
